mechanism: Two independent flaws: (1) pairs were split at random, so every test protein also appears in training and labels follow per-protein propensity — memorizing entity label rates reproduces most of the score; (2) the assay batch is confounded with the label (positives were mostly run in batch 1), so batch predicts the label without any biology. A valid review names BOTH: fixing only the split leaves the confounded batch; fixing only the batch leaves the memorization.
quantify: ~100% of test pairs share a protein with training
batch alone predicts the label with AUROC ~0.77
fix: Entity-disjoint split AND batch-matched (or batch-corrected) evaluation; report both baselines.
